name: surveyjs-firebase-module
description: A secure, independently deployable SurveyJS and Firebase survey module.

scripts.build: npm run contracts:check && npm run build --workspace @survey-module/web && npm run build --workspace @survey-module/functions
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:web:stage && firebase deploy --only hosting:dev-survey-machine
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting:prod-survey-machine
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-survey-module --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.smoke:staging: npm run check:env:stage && npm run build:web:stage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck --workspace @survey-module/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @survey-module/functions
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:rules && npm run build
